title: The owner's second round on the day-42 build: the party announced thirty seconds ahead with his four lines, the hull mends under the Stalheart, the cored Pearl tiers read as cored, the cave tied to the arena's sinkhole with its hand-off after Isao's lines, flares that grip slopes, PRESS Q for the LiDAR and a hundred-second fuse
context: Owner, 2026-10-18, on Day-42@aa964d2a, eight notes (kept verbatim in the session's ledger): 1) record voices for Isao to announce the party, 30 s before 'I know it's weird, but we need to celebrate', 'it's day number forty-two, Arthur would be proud', 10 s before 'Come back to the base, I have a surprise', then 'We survived 42 days!!! Congratulations!'; 2) 'the speed being an element to manage to RAM some enemies is a good mechanic' (feedback, kept); 3) 'when the Mork is damaged, sitting under the Stalheart should repair it, same repair time as the shield recharge'; 4) a cored enemy 'too hard to visually distinguish from harmless ones ... the core is slightly colored but the membrane is almost opaque white'; 5) the enemies feel different from the day before, 'Do not change anything yet' (held); 6) sector 9's triggers and road (its own entry); 7) the cave as the final mission linked to the arena's sinkhole, Isao's three lines, flares that stick to slopes, 'Press Q' when the LiDAR is available; 8) 'the maze is longer now, I think ISAO might need more time to be able to get out'.
outcome: Note 1: the party clock (src/domain/disco-party-clock.js) gains a 30 s COUNTDOWN before 'party': on the same arming conditions it says day_42_soon (glee: 'I know it's weird, but we need to celebrate.' / 'It's day number forty-two. Arthur would be proud.'), holds the sector clock from that moment, says day_42_back at 20 s ('Come back to the base. I have a surprise.'), then starts the party at 30 s with day_42 now 'We survived forty-two days! Congratulations!'; a hull death or the win cancels the countdown quietly, a seat, shot or card does not; lines Isao's one-deep panel cannot take wait up to DAY_42.sayWait 20 s (SOL-82's pass brief had dropped 'Party's over'), a stale 'come back' line is dropped at the start; voice list section 14 lists the four recording lines; --day-42 waits through the countdown. Note 3: src/domain/hull-repair.js (repairStep: progress while under the Stalheart and still, one dent back per whole unit, kept 5 s off the spot, reset by a hit) and src/fx/hull-repair.js; the time is SHIELD_ARRAY.reserve (30 s a whole hull, a dent every 7.5 s; HULL_REPAIR in src/content/tank.js); 'under' is the terminal prompt's own storyBase.inside('stalheart'); the hull console reads REPAIRING, HULL REPAIRED once whole; a parked hull mends while the player sits in a seat; harness state().hullRepair, parkHull(). Note 4: PEARL_MEMBRANE in src/content/pearl-enemies.js: cored tiers' membranes 0.26 (orange, green) and 0.4 (purple, brown, black; was 0.5), tinted 40 % toward the core (orange) or the belt's alarm hue (green, purple, brown), the glints 60 % toward the tint and black's fully red per enemyspec's dark-body rule; the shared membrane shader takes a glint colour that defaults to white, so the Cutis families draw as before; the death tone intact. Notes 7-8: descent_brief is three lines tying the arena's sinkhole to the way down, then the owner's own words; the cave (stalheart-cave day-42-notes 6e18948, vendored at below/) rests flares on slopes to 50 degrees under 0.9 m/s (FLARE_STICK; gravity beats the grip from 45 degrees), shows PRESS Q . LIDAR until the LiDAR is first used and clears it at extraction, spells out a FUSE of 100 s (the measured escape 74.3 s at a mouse-like turn rate, 56.6 s instant, 101.9 s keys only; 65 s left the reasonable run nothing); the descent host opens the cave on GAME time after the look at the hole and after the descent brief (DESCENT.briefCap 22 s from the brief's own start; src/domain/descent.js descentOpenDue), so the exposition is read before the frame covers the game.
alternatives: The party at a breath with no warning (the first build): the owner wants the player called back to the base; the 30 s countdown is the lull's first half.
A priority flag in showBrief so the party's lines preempt: td-tab has no byte slack; the module keeps its own held queue instead.
A 30 m circle round the Stalheart for 'under': the model sits 14.5 m off its holder, so the terminal prompt's footprint test was reused and the two agree.
Tinting cored membranes toward their cores: green, purple and brown have pale cores that would whiten the skin; their belt's alarm hue was used.
Keeping the cave's fixed 2.5 s open: the three-line brief played behind the frame and pushed the return joke past the ending.
evidence: test/disco-party-clock.mjs, test/disco-party.mjs, test/hull-repair.mjs, test/pearl-enemies.mjs, test/descent.mjs (descentOpenDue); the cave's test/flares.test.mjs (35 degrees rests, 70 slides, free fall at g) and test/mission.test.mjs; npm test 274 programs on the merged tree; npm run architecture (td-tab 6,186 of 6,400)

browser steps on the merged tree: --day-42 green (the countdown's two lines, the sector clock standing from the announcement, the party, the alarm), --descent green (the cave opened 24.1 game seconds after the hand-off with Isao's panel empty)
headless screenshots .superpowers/sdd/r2-b-*.png (REPAIRING, HULL REPAIRED), r2-c-close-compare.png and r2-c-bestiary-compare.png (cores through tinted skins), r2-e-cave-press-q.png

open for the owner: 30 s (the reserve) vs 15 s of pad time for the repair; the hard cores at 0.4 after his 'a bit less transparent' of 2026-10-16 (0.45 is the first knob); the cave opening about 24 s after the hand-off with the game running; a keys-only escape still runs out at 100 s
